course.title: Artificial Intelligence
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider a large adversarial game with a high branching factor and limited computation (12) [CO3] time per move. Compare Minimax without heuristic evaluation, Minimax with heuristic evaluation, and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) in terms of efficiency and optimality. Justify which method is most suitable for designing an intelligent agent under these constraints.
